stories.headline: Trump admin drafts AI chip export rules requiring licenses for all countries, tying sales to US investment

key_facts.fact: The Trump administration is drafting rules that would require Nvidia and AMD to obtain government approval before exporting AI chips to any country, with no exemptions planned even for key allies.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. government is planning to require export licenses for all AI chip shipments from companies like NVIDIA and AMD, with no exemptions currently planned, even for key allies.

key_facts.fact: Under the proposal, countries seeking 200,000+ AI chips may be required to commit investments in US-based AI infrastructure or provide government-level security guarantees; smaller orders up to 1,000 Nvidia GB300 racks could pass through a simpler review.
key_facts.excerpt: Large purchases (over 200,000 units) require host government involvement, security guarantees, and matching U.S. AI infrastructure investments. Shipments up to 1,000 NVIDIA GB300 racks could pass through 'fairly simple review.'

key_facts.fact: A 129-page draft is circulating through government, though a White House official pushed back, saying it 'does not reflect what President Trump has said on export controls.'
key_facts.excerpt: According to Axios, a 129-page draft is circulating through government. However, a White House official disputed its authenticity, stating it 'does not reflect what President Trump has said on export controls.'

key_facts.fact: The news sent semiconductor stocks lower: Nvidia shares dropped 1.9% and AMD fell 2.3% on Thursday.
key_facts.excerpt: The news sent semiconductor stocks lower: NVIDIA shares dropped 1.9% and AMD fell 2.3% on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: The new framework supersedes Biden's 'AI Diffusion' rule rescinded in May 2025, which was criticized as 'burdensome, overreaching, and disastrous,' and treats chips as foreign policy instruments rather than purely commercial products.
key_facts.excerpt: This approach supersedes Biden's 'AI Diffusion' rule (rescinded May 2025), which faced criticism as 'burdensome, overreaching, and disastrous.'

stories.headline: Nvidia revives RTX 3060 GPU via Samsung 8nm as DRAM shortage and AI demand squeeze consumer market

key_facts.fact: Samsung Foundry is preparing to restart 8nm production of Nvidia's GeForce RTX 3060 GPU, reviving the five-year-old Ampere card to address consumer GPU shortages caused by AI-driven memory demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Foundry is preparing to restart production lines for the GeForce RTX 3060... Samsung Foundry intends to restart production of the GeForce RTX 3060, indicating the model will be available soon.

key_facts.fact: Board partners are expected to receive RTX 3060 GPUs between March 10 and March 20, 2026, with both 8GB and 12GB GDDR6 variants available.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA will ship RTX 3060 cards to its board partners between March 10 and March 20.

key_facts.fact: The RTX 3060 uses GDDR6, an older memory standard far less contested by the AI industry, and Samsung's mature 8nm node, freeing up TSMC's constrained 5nm capacity for RTX 50 series and AI chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Foundry was a key asset for NVIDIA with Ampere GPUs during their initial launch back in 2021, and the firm provided them with the 8nm process.

key_facts.fact: Samsung DRAM prices doubled in Q1 2026, with hikes exceeding 100% for major clients including Apple, driven by AI-infrastructure HBM demand crowding out general DRAM supply.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics completed the final negotiations on the first quarter DRAM supply prices with major clients last month. The average price of general DRAM for servers, PCs, and mobile devices has increased by about 100% compared to the previous quarter.

stories.headline: WeRide and Geely sign deal to deliver 2,000 purpose-built robotaxis in 2026, tripling fleet size

key_facts.fact: WeRide and Geely's Farizon signed an expanded strategic cooperation agreement on March 8, announcing plans to deliver 2,000 upgraded, purpose-built, mass-produced Robotaxi GXRs by the end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD, HKEX: 0800)... today signed an expanded strategic cooperation agreement with Geely's Zhejiang Farizon New Energy Commercial Vehicle Group. The two companies announced plans to deliver 2,000 upgraded, purpose-built, mass-produced Robotaxi GXRs by 2026.

key_facts.fact: As of January 2026, WeRide's global robotaxi fleet had 1,023 vehicles; with 2,000 new GXRs, the fleet will surpass 2,600 this year, progressing toward tens of thousands by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: As of January 2026, WeRide's global Robotaxi fleet had 1,023 vehicles. With the addition of 2,000 new Robotaxi GXRs, WeRide expects its global operating Robotaxi fleet to surpass 2,600 Robotaxis this year.

key_facts.fact: The upgraded GXR is equipped with WeRide's GEN8 autonomous driving system featuring a thousand-line LiDAR with 17x point-cloud resolution increase and 600-meter detection range.
key_facts.excerpt: Equipped with WeRide's latest GEN8 autonomous driving system... GEN8, built around WeRide's Sensor Suite 8.0 (SS8.0), enhances vehicle safety, consistency, and long-term operational reliability. Its thousand-line LiDAR increases point-cloud resolution by 17x.

key_facts.fact: The new Robotaxi GXR is scheduled to roll off the production line in Q3 2026, with vehicles deployed in both domestic Chinese and overseas markets including the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
key_facts.excerpt: The new model is scheduled to officially roll off the production line in the third quarter of 2026... deployed in both domestic and overseas markets.

stories.headline: SpaceX completes first Starship V3 cryoproof test on Ship 39, clearing path toward Flight 12

key_facts.fact: SpaceX completed cryoproof operations on Ship 39, the first next-generation Starship V3 upper stage, testing the vehicle's redesigned propellant system and structural strength over several days at Starbase, Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: Ship 39 Completes Cryoproof Tests for Next-Gen Starship V3... Across several days, engineers tested the vehicle's redesigned propellant system and its structural strength, including squeeze tests to mimic the forces of future ship catches.

key_facts.fact: The V3 redesign features a unified header tank setup, 10-15% increased tank capacity for extended missions, reinforced forward flap hinges, and is designed for Raptor 3 engines.
key_facts.excerpt: A streamlined 'unified header tank setup' replacing previous bulky headers and feed lines prone to icing or leaks. Tank Capacity: Increased 10-15% for extended missions.

key_facts.fact: Squeeze tests simulated compressive loads from future tower catches, validating the V3 structure for SpaceX's planned mechazilla catch maneuver.
key_facts.excerpt: Vehicle was subjected to 'compressive loads' simulating tower capture forces.

key_facts.fact: Starship has not launched in nearly five months; Flight 12 featuring Ship 39 is targeted for early 2026, pending static fires and FAA approval. The upcoming test will debut Starship Version 3.
key_facts.excerpt: The world's largest rocket has not gotten off the ground in nearly five months from SpaceX's Starbase headquarters... The upcoming test will debut Starship Version 3, a larger and more powerful iteration of the rocket.

stories.headline: NHTSA hosts first national AV safety forum with Waymo, Zoox, Aurora CEOs; Tesla left off main panel

key_facts.fact: NHTSA will hold a National AV Safety Forum on March 10 at USDOT Headquarters in Washington, featuring a fireside chat with Waymo co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana, Zoox CEO Aicha Evans, and Aurora CEO Chris Urmson.
key_facts.excerpt: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration holds its National AV Safety Forum on March 10 in Washington, D.C., a day-long session at USDOT Headquarters that will feature a fireside chat between NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison and the chief executives of Waymo, Zoox, and Aurora.

key_facts.fact: Tesla is listed on the AV Showcase at Automation Plaza outside but is not included in the executive panel discussion, despite being one of the most prominent autonomous driving companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla is listed on the venue's AV Showcase on Automation Plaza outside but is not included in the executive panel discussion.

key_facts.fact: NHTSA is reviewing potential actions including issuing future guidance on the safe development, testing, and deployment of self-driving vehicles, and will discuss remote assistance use and how to measure robotaxi performance versus human drivers.
key_facts.excerpt: NHTSA is evaluating possible steps, including issuing future guidance on the safe domestic development, testing and deployment of self-driving vehicles. The day-long forum will also discuss the use of remote assistance in robotaxis and how regulators should measure robotaxi performance against human-driven vehicles.

key_facts.fact: The forum comes as a Waymo vehicle was filmed blocking an ambulance responding to the March 1 mass shooting in Austin, Texas, reigniting safety debates around autonomous vehicles.
key_facts.excerpt: A viral image from the March 1 shooting in downtown Austin — an autonomous vehicle blocking an ambulance from reaching the scene where a gunman fatally wounded three people and injured 15 others — has put a spotlight on driverless cars.

stories.headline: US Army deploys Ukraine-tested Merops counter-drone system to Middle East against Iranian Shaheds

key_facts.fact: The US Army is deploying the Merops counter-drone system, which has intercepted over 1,000 Shahed-type drones in Ukraine, to the Middle East to counter Iranian drone attacks during Operation Epic Fury.
key_facts.excerpt: The US Army is deploying an American-made counter-drone system that has intercepted more than 1,000 Shahed-type drones in Ukraine to the Middle East, two defense officials confirmed on Saturday to Business Insider.

key_facts.fact: The Merops interceptor drones cost approximately $15,000 each, versus $13.5 million for a Patriot PAC-3 missile, addressing the cost-exchange problem of using expensive missiles against cheap Iranian drones costing $20,000-$50,000.
key_facts.excerpt: The counter-drone system, which uses a roughly $15,000 interceptor, would give US and allied forces a much cheaper air defense option against Iranian drones, compared to expensive surface-to-air missiles.

key_facts.fact: Merops is produced by Perennial Autonomy, a company in which billionaire Eric Schmidt is an investor; the systems are being sent from US Army stocks in Europe along with US personnel to operate and train troops.
key_facts.excerpt: A small number of the defensive systems, dubbed Merops, are being sent from U.S. Army stocks in Europe, along with U.S. personnel to operate them and train other troops... produced by Perennial Autonomy, in which billionaire Eric Schmidt is an investor.

key_facts.fact: Gulf states including Qatar have been sending representatives to meet with Ukrainian arms manufacturers to learn from their drone-defense experience and build supply chains.
key_facts.excerpt: Representatives of Qatar and other Gulf states targeted by Iranian drones and missiles have traveled to meet with Ukrainian arms manufacturers and learn from their experience in building supply chains.

stories.headline: Ex-Google researchers launch Integral AI in Tokyo, pitch self-learning robots to Japan's top manufacturers

key_facts.fact: Integral AI, founded by former Google researchers Jad Tarifi and Nima Asgharbeygi, has set up operations in Tokyo and is in preliminary talks with Toyota, Sony, Honda, Nissan, and Mitsui Chemicals to bring AI that teaches industrial robots new skills by watching demonstrations.
key_facts.excerpt: The 15-person startup is engaging in preliminary talks with Toyota Motor Corp., Sony Group Corp., Honda Motor Co., Nissan Motor Co., and Mitsui Chemicals Inc. to present their vision of how artificial intelligence can enhance manufacturing processes.

key_facts.fact: Integral AI has worked with auto parts maker Denso Corp. since 2021 to help teach industrial robots new skills by observing human demonstrations, and plans to release its Genesis AI model later in 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has collaborated with auto parts manufacturer Denso Corp. since 2021 to facilitate the teaching of new skills to industrial robots through observation of demonstrations.

key_facts.fact: Founder Jad Tarifi, 42, initiated Google's first generative AI team in 2013; the startup has raised $5.5 million and is seeking another $10 million ahead of its Genesis model launch.
key_facts.excerpt: Tarifi, age 42, initiated Google's first generative AI team in 2013... Integral has raised approximately $5.5 million to date and is pursuing around $10 million in new funding.

key_facts.fact: Japan hosts 29% of the global industrial robot supply through companies like Fanuc and Yaskawa, but Tarifi says 'Japan is strong in robotics, but they're not strong in AI and computing.'
key_facts.excerpt: Japanese companies accounting for an estimated 29 percent of the global supply of industrial robots... 'Japan is strong in robotics, but they're not strong in AI and computing,' Tarifi stated.

stories.headline: Agility Robotics expands Digit humanoid deployments to Toyota, GXO, and Schaeffler to fill labor gaps

key_facts.fact: Agility Robotics' chief business officer Daniel Diez told Business Insider that companies worldwide face labor gaps in manufacturing, and Digit humanoid robots are being deployed at Amazon, Schaeffler, GXO, and now Toyota's Canadian manufacturing plant.
key_facts.excerpt: Agility's chief business officer, Daniel Diez, said companies see labor gaps in these positions. The company says its robot, Digit, will take on jobs involving highly repetitive tasks. Agility Robotics is deploying humanoid robots at Toyota's Canada manufacturing plant.

key_facts.fact: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada signed a commercial Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) agreement with Agility in February 2026 after a successful year-long pilot with three Digits, and plans to deploy seven more to load and unload totes.
key_facts.excerpt: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada's pilot involved three Digits and included development, proof-of-technology, and onsite phases. The company said it plans to deploy seven more humanoids to load and unload totes from an automated tugger.

key_facts.fact: TMMC is Toyota's largest manufacturing operation outside Japan, assembling over 535,000 vehicles in 2025 with 8,500 employees; it recently committed $1.1 billion to build the 6th generation RAV4.
key_facts.excerpt: TMMC is Toyota Motor Corp.'s largest manufacturing operation outside of Japan, with vehicle assembly plants in Cambridge and Woodstock, Ontario... it employs over 8,500 people. The company last month said it will build its 6th generation RAV4 at TMMC's plants, investing $1.1 billion.

key_facts.fact: Diez said the pattern is consistent in Germany, Korea, Japan, and the US: manufacturers cannot find enough workers willing to do mundane, repetitive jobs, creating a structural opportunity for humanoid robots.
key_facts.excerpt: In Germany, Korea, Japan, or the US, manufacturers just don't have enough people who want to work mundane, repetitive jobs.
